offering_description.value: Wholesale specialty insurance broker and underwriting manager that places hard-to-place risks with insurers and Lloyd's capacity for retail agencies and businesses. It earns commissions and fees by distributing, underwriting and administering specialty insurance programs.

primary_products.value: specialty insurance policies; binding authority programs; excess and surplus lines coverage

primary_services.value: wholesale insurance brokerage; underwriting management; program administration; claims services

customer_segment.value: B2B: retail insurance agencies and brokers, businesses buying specialty liability, property and professional coverage

end_markets.value: construction; real estate; healthcare; financial institutions; energy

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: brokerage commissions and underwriting management fees on specialty policies; service fees: program administration and claims handling fees
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: wholesale brokerage and claims services sold to retail agents; financial intermediary: underwrites and binds risk through managing general agents and Lloyd's syndicate capacity, sold to retail brokers

geography_served.value: global: primarily US states, also UK and other international markets through London and Lloyd's

specialization.value: related lines: wholesale brokerage, underwriting management and binding programs across property, casualty and professional lines

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: retail insurance agencies and brokers that place business through its wholesale platform

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed insurance brokerage and underwriting regulated by state insurance departments and UK regulators, including Lloyd's
